steps.description: Gather user preferences and details for the road trip such as start location, end location, and travel dates
Generate a detailed road trip itinerary including route, stops, and estimated travel times
Estimate travel expenses including fuel, accommodation, food, and other costs based on the itinerary
Create and manage a budget plan for the road trip expenses
Track and update actual expenses during the road trip
